fact: On 6 November 2026 a Ministry of Social Solidarity official said the National Social Registry, holding 13 million households, about half of Egypt's households, is linked to 27 government databases through the national number.
title: التضامن: ربط بيانات 13 مليون أسرة بـ27 قاعدة حكومية لتعزيز دقة استهداف مستحقي الدعم
